training_source: Synthetic templates authored and structurally reviewed in this session; not independently human-labeled.
label_rule: Discussed/historical/rejected instructions are benign; active redirection of the current assistant is attack. Quotation alone never sets the label.
checks: No normalized exact overlap with original splits
